tools.name: resolve_jurisdiction
tools.description: Where is the media bought? Resolve a market (e.g. FR, UK, US, Japan) to one of the 20 markets on the record. UK is the label; GB is accepted.

tools.name: resolve_actor
tools.description: Who is asking? maker, brand_owner, agency, distributor or retailer_media_team (trade); auditor (read only). The consumer is never the counterparty.

tools.name: gate_transaction
tools.description: The gate before a handshake: allow or deny for one market and one actor class. Returns a decision_id the handshake tools ask for. A deny is not charged.

tools.name: find_makers
tools.description: Find the brand: makers on the grocery record of one market (node = one of the 20 markets). segment is taken as a lane where it names one (organic, free-from, plant-based, artisan, origin, premium). Read live from the A2A Grocery door.

tools.name: resolve_gtin
tools.description: Confirm the product is real: is this Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) well-formed, and is it on the grocery record, with its brand and maker. Read live from the A2A Grocery door.

tools.name: check_eligibility
tools.description: Confirm it is on the shelf: does the grocery record list this GTIN at this banner in this market? No listing, no media pitch. Read live from the A2A Grocery door.

tools.name: list_banners
tools.description: Pick the banners: the grocery banners of one market with each one's media program (or "none listed") and card status. with_program=true returns only banners with a program listed.

tools.name: get_banner_card
tools.description: The signed card of one banner and its status (unclaimed, claimed or registered). banner = the banner's slug, id or name.

tools.name: list_banner_cards
tools.description: The cards of one market, optionally by status (unclaimed, claimed, registered): banner, media program, status and the card's address.

tools.name: list_packages
tools.description: Match a package: what one banner's media program says it sells, in the program's own words, each tagged onsite, offsite or in-store. Offsite is tagged so it is never taken for a shelf slot. Empty where no program is listed — the agent stops.

tools.name: quote_package
tools.description: Price it: returns where the banner's own media program publishes its rates or takes an enquiry. GSC never prices; a quote comes from the retailer's program.

tools.name: find_buyer
tools.description: Qualify the buyer: find a maker on the grocery record by name, with its own website where the record has one.

tools.name: submit_demand
tools.description: Hand off: the packet — the maker, a budget a person has approved, one or more GTINs, a market and a list of banners — or a gap naming what is missing. Routes each banner by its card status: unclaimed is a referral, claimed goes to the retailer's media team, registered goes agent to agent. Settles at

tools.name: receive_demand
tools.description: Retailer side: a registered program agent takes a qualified packet. Only a card in the registered state can receive; any other card is refused and nothing is charged.

tools.name: a2a_handoff
tools.description: Hand to a person: the state of a handoff and its Navigator desk ticket, where the media program has no agent.

tools.name: pull_measurement
tools.description: Read the till: results of a campaign, returned by the retailer's program. Available only after the program returns a campaign id for a handoff.

tools.name: renew_package
tools.description: Renew: a prior quote id from the retailer's program and a new approved budget. Without a quote id from the program there is nothing to renew.

tools.name: log_audit
tools.description: Write one audit line for a step of the chain; returns its id.

tools.name: enrol_maker
tools.description: Makers: be seen. Enrol a maker for media exposure in grocery: its name, its markets (one or more of the 20), the tick, and a contact a person can answer. Enrolment only — a handoff waits for a budget a person has approved.
